5042: /*
5043:  * Write 'call_nif_early' as the first beam instruction for all NIFs
5044:  * which will make them callable.
5045:  *
5046:  * The 'call_nif_early' is a one word beam instruction which uses a lock
5047:  * protected hash lookup to get its "arguments". This guarantees an atomically
5048:  * safe publication of all NIFs in the module.

854: # The load_nif/2 BIF is an instruction.

857: call_ext u==2 u$func:erlang:load_nif/2 =>
858:     i_load_nif
859: call_ext_last u==2 u$func:erlang:load_nif/2 D =>
860:     i_load_nif | deallocate_return D
861: call_ext_only u==2 u$func:erlang:load_nif/2 =>
862:     i_load_nif | return
